Source: this issue's untimed cell records under `cells/`, the frozen
`c077a88b` prepared quality records, the protocol's frozen shared settings
and the predeclared tolerances. Marginal FER intervals are Wilson at the
frozen quality confidence; marginal BER intervals are the protocol's
frame-bounded Hoeffding interval at the same level. The paired bound uses
the corrected level `0.004166667`, which is the frozen family alpha
divided by a first attempt's factor of two and by the six cells the
bootstrap tail-support rule admits; a confirmation recomputes it from its
own ledger.
